item.title: DOJ Targets $1B in USDC Tied to North Korea’s Binance Hack
item.description: The U.S. Justice Department wants to seize nearly $1 billion in USDC connected to the October Binance hack. Prosecutors filed a civil forfeiture complaint in Washington on November 23, identifying funds held across 36 addresses on 18 blockchains. Investigators have linked the…

item.title: Chainflip Loses $12.6M as Validator Flaw Exposes Bitcoin, Ethereum Vaults
item.description: Chainflip has lost approximately $12.6 million after an attacker exploited its validator network and drained funds from its Bitcoin and Ethereum vaults on November 21. The cross-chain protocol confirmed the theft in an incident report published November 23. Chainflip Labs said…
